title: Multi-destination cost/time tradeoff comparison
description: Compare two or three candidate destinations on cost, time, and tradeoffs, surfacing disagreement between analysts rather than a flat average.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: multi-destination-tradeoff
  title: "Multi-destination cost/time tradeoff comparison"
  description: Compare two or three candidate destinations on cost, time, and tradeoffs, surfacing disagreement between analysts rather than a flat average.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give the traveler a clear, disagreement-aware comparison of candidate destinations plus a reasoned recommendation.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 3, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Candidate destinations and constraints
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The candidate destinations, travel window, traveler count, and any budget or time constraints. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: destination-a-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Destination A analyst
      role: Independent analyst estimating cost and time tradeoffs for one candidate destination.
      prompt: Estimate the relative cost tier, travel time, and notable tradeoffs for the first candidate destination, describing ranges and dependencies rather than asserting exact prices. Note factors that could shift the estimate and flag anything time-sensitive to re-check nearer to booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { destination: { type: string }, cost_tier: { type: string }, time_estimate: { type: string }, tradeoffs: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: destination-b-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Destination B analyst
      role: Independent analyst estimating cost and time tradeoffs for one candidate destination.
      prompt: Estimate the relative cost tier, travel time, and notable tradeoffs for the second candidate destination, describing ranges and dependencies rather than asserting exact prices. Note factors that could shift the estimate and flag anything time-sensitive to re-check nearer to booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { destination: { type: string }, cost_tier: { type: string }, time_estimate: { type: string }, tradeoffs: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: destination-c-analyst
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Destination C analyst
      role: Independent analyst estimating cost and time tradeoffs for one candidate destination.
      prompt: Estimate the relative cost tier, travel time, and notable tradeoffs for the third candidate destination, describing ranges and dependencies rather than asserting exact prices. Note factors that could shift the estimate and flag anything time-sensitive to re-check nearer to booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, domain-analysis], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { destination: { type: string }, cost_tier: { type: string }, time_estimate: { type: string }, tradeoffs: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: candidates-group
      kind: group
      name: Parallel destination analyses
      config: { members: [destination-a-analyst, destination-b-analyst, destination-c-analyst], execution: parallel, exit: aggregate }
    - id: tradeoff-vote
      kind: aggregator
      name: Surface agreement and disagreement across analysts
      config: { aggregation: vote }
    - id: recommendation
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Recommend a destination with reasoning
      role: Independent evaluator who weighs the analysts' estimates and any disagreement between them.
      prompt: Review the aggregated cost/time estimates and any disagreement across analysts, then recommend a destination with clear reasoning that names the tradeoffs a decision-maker should weigh. Explicitly call out where analysts disagreed rather than smoothing it into an average. Flag which figures are estimates that should be reconfirmed before booking.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation, domain-analysis], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [recommended_destination, reasoning, disagreement_notes], properties: { recommended_destination: { type: string }, reasoning: { type: string }, disagreement_notes: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Destination comparison and recommendation
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: candidates-group, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: candidates-group, to: tradeoff-vote, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: tradeoff-vote, to: recommendation, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: recommendation, to: result, kind: data }
